readme:
# JOIN Jobs Scraper: Company Career Pages

Get the open jobs of any company that hires through [JOIN](https://join.com). Paste a JOIN company page URL such as `https://join.com/companies/gokonfetti` (or just the company name) and receive title, location, apply URL and, when the site provides them, department, employment type, workplace type, posting date and the job description as clean dataset rows.

## What you can do with it

- Pull all open roles of a list of target companies for lead generation or recruiting research.
- Track hiring over time: run it on a schedule with `postedWithinDays` and `sortBy: newest` to see only new postings.
- Feed a job board or alert system with the openings of the companies you follow.
- Filter by keyword in the title, by location or by country.

## What you get

One dataset row per job. Duplicates are removed before anything is charged, so the number of rows is the number of results you pay for.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `id` | Job id, unique across JOIN company pages |
| `ats_job_id` | The id JOIN uses for the posting |
| `title` | Job title |
| `ats_platform` | `join` |
| `company` | The company's name as its JOIN page states it |
| `company_legacy` | Original company name as the site wrote it, only when the company name was normalised (for example a trailing number removed) |
| `location`, `city`, `country` | Location text as posted (city and country), the city and the two-letter country code, when the site provides a location |
| `department` | Job category, when the site provides it |
| `employment_type` | Full-time, part-time, contract, internship and so on, when the site provides it (read from the posting page when `includeDescription` is on) |
| `remote` | `true` when the posting is marked remote |
| `workplace_type` | `remote`, `hybrid` or `on_site`, when the site provides it; empty when the posting does not say |
| `description` | Full job description as HTML, read from the posting page. Empty when `includeDescription` is off or the posting page could not be read |
| `apply_url`, `job_url` | Link to the application page and to the posting |
| `created_at`, `updated_at` | Date and time (UTC) the job was created on JOIN, and its last update when the page gives one |
| `language` | Language of the posting, when it can be determined |
| `scraped_at` | Time of the run |

## Input

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `companies` | JOIN company page URLs or bare company names (`gokonfetti` is `https://join.com/companies/gokonfetti`). Strings, `{"url": "..."}` objects, a single string, or several separated by commas or new lines. Empty = one sample JOIN company page. |
| `keywords` | Keep only jobs whose title matches at least one keyword. They filter the jobs of the JOIN company pages you list; they do not search other companies. |
| `location` | Keep only jobs in this city, region or country (`Geneva`, `Switzerland`, `CH`). |
| `countries` | ISO-2 codes such as `["CH", "DE"]`: keep only jobs located in these countries (jobs whose country cannot be determined are left out). |
| `includeRemoteWithoutRegion` | Only with a country filter: also keep remote jobs that state no country or region (they may not be open to applicants in that country). Default `false`. |
| `postedWithinDays` | Drop jobs older than this many days. Jobs without a posting date are kept. |
| `sortBy` | `newest` (default: a cap returns the newest jobs of the company, which needs every page of the company page, 5 jobs each) or `relevance` (the page's own order). |
| `maxJobsPerCompany` | Cap per company page, counted after the filters. `0` = all. Default 50. |
| `maxResults` | Cap for the whole run. The run stops cleanly when it is reached. `0` = no limit. Default 100. |

### Example: one company page

```json
{
  "companies": ["https://join.com/companies/gokonfetti"],
  "maxResults": 20
}
```

### Example: several JOIN company pages with filters

```json
{
  "companies": [
    "https://join.com/companies/gokonfetti",
    "https://join.com/companies/acme"
  ],
  "keywords": ["engineer", "data"],
  "postedWithinDays": 30,
  "sortBy": "newest",
  "maxJobsPerCompany": 25
}
```

Only JOIN company pages are read. A URL of any other job system (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday and so on) is skipped with a log line that names the actor to use, and is never charged.

### Supported URL formats

- Company page: `https://join.com/companies/{company}` (with or without a trailing slash, or without `https://`; tracking parameters such as `utm_source` are ignored).
- Posting: `https://join.com/companies/{company}/{job-id-and-title}` is reduced to its company page; the whole page is read.
- Bare company name: `{company}`.

## Output

```json
{
  "id": "join-5e1f0c2a-14760699",
  "ats_job_id": "14760699",
  "title": "Sales Development Representative DACH (m/f/d)",
  "company": "AGICAP Deutschland",
  "ats_platform": "join",
  "location": "Berlin, Germany",
  "city": "Berlin",
  "country": "DE",
  "department": "Sales",
  "employment_type": "Employee",
  "remote": false,
  "workplace_type": "hybrid",
  "apply_url": "https://join.com/companies/agicap/jobs/16762734-sales-development-representative-dach-m-f-d/apply",
  "job_url": "https://join.com/companies/agicap/jobs/16762734-sales-development-representative-dach-m-f-d",
  "created_at": "2025-08-28T08:34:07Z",
  "scraped_at": "2026-10-28T09:00:00Z"
}
```

Field values vary by company; the id hash and the run time are examples.

## Pricing

Pay per result, two events:

- `apify-actor-start`: $0.001 once per run.
- `job-result`: $0.001 per job in the dataset ($1.00 per 1,000 jobs).

The start fee is charged on top of the job results. Filtered-out and duplicate jobs are never charged, and a company page that is not found costs nothing. Set a maximum total charge on the run to stop at a budget; the run ends cleanly when it is reached. The pricing box on the actor page always shows the current rates.

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client, such as Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Example prompts once connected:**

> "Use `join-jobs-scraper` for https://join.com/companies/gokonfetti and list the open roles with title, location and apply URL."

> "Use `join-jobs-scraper` for the companies gokonfetti and acme and return the roles posted in the last 30 days."

Configure the MCP server with the JOIN Jobs Scraper preconfigured at `mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/join-jobs-scraper`:

```json
{
    "mcpServers": {
        "apify": {
            "command": "npx",
            "args": [
                "mcp-remote",
                "https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=santamaria-automations/join-jobs-scraper",
                "--header",
                "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_TOKEN>"
            ]
        }
    }
}
```

See the auto-generated API tab on the actor page for language-specific examples (cURL, JavaScript, Python, and more).

## FAQ

**How do I find a company's JOIN company page URL?**
Open the company's careers page. If the address starts with `join.com/companies/`, that is the URL (for example `https://join.com/companies/gokonfetti`). You can pass either the URL or just the name after `/companies/`.

**Can I search by keyword across all JOIN companies?**
No. Give the URL or name of each company. Keywords only filter the titles of the jobs of the company pages you list.

**What if a company page is not found?**
The run continues with the other JOIN company pages. The run status line names the company page and the reason (for example `board_not_found`), and nothing is charged for it.

**Why is a description or salary missing?**
The JOIN company page lists title, place, category, type, work arrangement and date of each job but not the job text. With `includeDescription` on (default) the actor reads each posting page for the description. A row whose posting page cannot be read keeps its list fields and has no description. JOIN shows no salary amount, so the salary fields stay empty.

**How do I get only new jobs?**
Run it on a schedule with `postedWithinDays` set to the interval (for example `1` for a daily run) and `sortBy` set to `newest`.

**How do I stop at a budget?**
Set `maxResults` or the maximum total charge of the run. The run stops cleanly when either is reached.

**Why did I get fewer jobs than `maxJobsPerCompany`?**
The caps apply after your filters, and a company page can simply have fewer open jobs. The JOIN company pages are read in the order you list them, and the run stops once `maxResults` is reached.

## Limits

- Company pages only; no company-name search across JOIN.
- The description needs one extra request per job (turn `includeDescription` off to skip it). Salary amounts are not shown by JOIN and stay empty.
- `workplace_type` is empty for postings that do not state a work arrangement.
